messages:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout: api-service v2.3.1-rc5 -> 10% traffic in us-east-1. change-window 2026-03-21 09:00-11:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.3.1-rc5

amanda.k: seeing p99 jump on the dashboard, p50 stable. p99 ~760ms last 5m, 5xx rate ~0.9% (baseline ~0.05%). dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/api-service/latency

chris: good catch. I can already see a cluster of traces pointing to `complete-stream` handler timeouts. Not widespread yet but correlated with warmup of the new model routing.

sasha: @chris @amanda.k can we pause the rollout and pin traffic back to v2.3.0 until we get a quick root-cause? Prefer to avoid blast radius across other regions. :raised_hand:

ops-bot: Alert: api-service us-east-1 5xx spike detected. 1m rate: 0.95% -> automated anomaly policy TR-A1 triggered.

leo: +1 to pausing. Also check KV cache miss rate — new binary changed cache key hashing in rc5 earlier today.

amanda.k: running quick query on cache miss now, but agree pause first. chris can you run a throttle/pin?

chris: doing a targeted hold for the staged rollout now. Will pin routing for the staged cohort to the previous stable while we investigate. Command:```/release pin service=api-service cohort=staged version=v2.3.0```

chris: sent. Please confirm when you see traffic shift.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 10%. Cohort pinned to v2.3.0 for staged traffic. Notifying on-call. (action_id=rl-4791002468-pause)

ops-bot: Confirmed: routing change applied, 10% cohort now served by v2.3.0. Telemetry will be backfilled in ~60s.

amanda.k: seeing 5xx rate drop to 0.12% after pin, p99 back to ~210ms. Good rollback signal.

sasha: thanks everyone. Quick next steps: 1) collect traces for rc5 to identify cache key change impact; 2) hold rc5 until we have a patch; 3) schedule a short post-mortem in #postmortems if we discover a regression. Who owns trace triage? @chris?

chris: I’ll take trace triage now and post findings in 30m. If it's the cache hashing, we should ship a hotfix and re-run a micro-canary (1%) behind feature flag.

leo: I’ll open a change-window addendum and update the release notes to reflect the pause and pin: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.3.1-rc5/notes (editing)

sasha: tagging @oncall to keep an eye during the window. Thanks all — staying on this thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
